# netbox_custom_link (Resource)

Manages a NetBox custom link (`/api/extras/custom-links/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_custom_link" "example" {
  object_types = []
  name = "example"
  link_text = "example"
  link_url = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `link_text` (String) Jinja2 template code for link text.
- `link_url` (String) Jinja2 template code for link URL.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `object_types` (Set of String) Object Types.

### Optional

- `button_class` (String) The class of the first link in a group will be used for the dropdown button. Valid values: `default`, `blue`, `indigo`, `purple`, `pink`, `red`, `orange`, `yellow`, `green`, `teal`, `cyan`, `gray`, `black`, `white`, `ghost-dark`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `group_name` (String) Links with the same group will appear as a dropdown menu. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `new_window` (Boolean) Force link to open in a new window. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `weight` (Number) Weight. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_custom_link can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_custom_link.example 123
```
